scope: stage0 OS-process driver, not FileGate product acceptance
why_isolated_process_checks_are_needed: The full VM path requires a user-terminal LaunchAgent proof. Before running it, real OS signals/pipes/process groups must verify the concrete broker-survives-Ctrl-C failure; pure result mocks cannot detect a surviving process.
failure_modes: Popen fails before any child exists: retain preparation intent; no invented stop proof
timeout while child/descendant live: interrupt dedicated control group, bounded kill/wait if required
group leader exits on interrupt but grandchild ignores it: still kill the remaining owned process group
PID/PGID reuse while stopping: retain the direct child unreaped until the final group signal; never signal an already reaped child group
output exceeds 1 MiB: stop producer while receiving; no unbounded drain/buffer
selector/read raises after process creation: same bounded stop and wait
suite receives SIGINT/KeyboardInterrupt: separate broker group may not survive the caller
a second SIGINT during cleanup: finish the bounded child-group stop before restoring the interrupt handler
output EOF before process exit: bounded wait; no success from EOF alone
preparation fails before prepared.json: known run/raw identity remains tied to 4 GiB reservation
source/catalog/proof changes between cases: refuse the next preparation and run
missing native stop or label proof: retain raw reservation and stop suite
artifact copy fails/exceeds bound: fail case; reclaim raw only if separate stop proof is complete
raw unlink/directory sync fails: do not finalize reservation charge
minimum_isolated_cases: real SIGINT to controller with separate child group
forbidden_inference: These isolated process checks do not prove QEMU/HVF, actual LaunchAgent cleanup, AV or full application crash recovery
